storage: Keep tightly closed in a dry spot away from spices and moisture. Test old soda by dropping a pinch into vinegar; it should fizz hard.
looksLike: Fine, white, odourless powder (sodium bicarbonate) with a faintly salty-soapy taste, sold in small jars or pouches labelled baking soda, cooking soda or meetha soda.
howToPick: Buy a sealed pack labelled sodium bicarbonate; it should be dry, white and free-flowing. Old or damp soda is clumped and weak.
shelfLife: Long (often 1 to 2 years sealed), but it loses punch in humid air (general guidance, not from a source this run).
substitutes: Baking powder (about 3 times as much by volume)
